BRACE 4/6

Pause
Normal
PRIMARY
Obliques
SECONDARY
Core, Shoulders

Instructions

Preparation: Lie on your side with your forearm on the floor, elbow under your shoulder. Stack your feet (or stagger for easier) and brace your core. Lift your hips off the floor into a straight line from head to feet.

1

Keep your elbow beneath your shoulder.

2

Keep your feet stacked and steady.

3

Keep head, hips and feet aligned.

4

Keep your hips raised and core braced.

5

Breathe normally without dropping your hips.

6

Hold for time; then repeat opposite side.
